<document id="fx-fees-plus-v2">
ForeignˆtransactionˆfeesˆonˆPlusˆOnˆtheˆPlusˆplan,ˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆisˆ1%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆinˆUSˆdollars.ˆ##ˆWhenˆitˆappliesˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆinˆaˆstoreˆorˆonlineˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆprocessedˆbyˆaˆmerchantˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆItˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroad.ˆThoseˆhaveˆtheˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆaˆpurchaseˆconvertsˆtoˆaˆgivenˆdollarˆamount,ˆtheˆfeeˆisˆ1%ˆofˆthatˆamount.ˆIt'sˆaddedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆcalledˆ"Foreignˆtransactionˆfee",ˆonˆtheˆsameˆdayˆtheˆpurchaseˆsettles.ˆ##ˆExchangeˆrateˆWeˆuseˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆtransactionˆsettles,ˆwithˆnoˆmarkup.ˆChooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆwhenˆaˆterminalˆoffersˆtoˆchargeˆyouˆinˆdollars.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆIfˆaˆforeignˆpurchaseˆisˆrefunded,ˆweˆalsoˆrefundˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆonˆtheˆrefundedˆamount.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆconvertedˆatˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles.ˆIfˆyouˆtravelˆoften,ˆPremiumˆhasˆnoˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="fx-fees-basic">
ForeignˆtransactionˆfeesˆonˆBasicˆOnˆtheˆBasicˆplan,ˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆisˆ3%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆinˆUSˆdollars.ˆ##ˆWhenˆitˆappliesˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrency,ˆinˆaˆstoreˆorˆonlineˆ-ˆPurchasesˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆprocessedˆbyˆaˆmerchantˆoutsideˆtheˆUSˆItˆdoesn'tˆapplyˆtoˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroad.ˆThoseˆhaveˆtheˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆaˆpurchaseˆconvertsˆtoˆaˆgivenˆdollarˆamount,ˆtheˆfeeˆisˆ3%ˆofˆthatˆamount.ˆIt'sˆaddedˆasˆaˆseparateˆlineˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeed,ˆcalledˆ"Foreignˆtransactionˆfee",ˆonˆtheˆsameˆdayˆtheˆpurchaseˆsettles.ˆ##ˆExchangeˆrateˆWeˆuseˆtheˆcardˆnetwork'sˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆtheˆtransactionˆsettles,ˆwithˆnoˆmarkup.ˆChooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆwhenˆaˆterminalˆoffersˆtoˆchargeˆyouˆinˆdollars.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆIfˆaˆforeignˆpurchaseˆisˆrefunded,ˆweˆalsoˆrefundˆtheˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆonˆtheˆrefundedˆamount.ˆTheˆrefundˆisˆconvertedˆatˆtheˆrateˆonˆtheˆdayˆitˆsettles.ˆIfˆyouˆtravelˆoften,ˆPremiumˆhasˆnoˆforeignˆtransactionˆfee.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="support-power-of-attorney">
PowerˆofˆattorneyˆIfˆyouˆhaveˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆforˆaˆTallowbrookˆmember,ˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteamˆcanˆaddˆyouˆtoˆtheirˆaccountˆasˆanˆagent.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆneedˆ-ˆAˆcopyˆofˆtheˆpowerˆofˆattorneyˆdocument,ˆsignedˆandˆinˆeffectˆ-ˆYourˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆYourˆcontactˆdetailsˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆsendˆitˆEmailˆsupport@tallowbrook.exampleˆwithˆtheˆsubjectˆPowerˆofˆattorney,ˆorˆaskˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆtoˆmessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheirˆsession.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreviewˆtheˆdocuments.ˆTheyˆgoˆtoˆAccountˆServices.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆitˆtakesˆAccountˆServicesˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdaysˆtoˆconfirmˆwhatˆtheyˆreceived,ˆandˆmayˆaskˆforˆmoreˆinformation.ˆ##ˆUntilˆit'sˆapprovedˆWeˆcan'tˆshareˆinformationˆorˆtakeˆinstructionsˆfromˆyouˆuntilˆAccountˆServicesˆhasˆapprovedˆtheˆdocument.ˆThatˆincludesˆfreezingˆcardsˆorˆchangingˆplans.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆinˆdangerˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆtheˆaccountˆholderˆisˆbeingˆexploitedˆfinancially,ˆtellˆus.ˆWeˆtreatˆthatˆasˆurgent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
